scope: Current source hashes identify the distributed Lean files. Compiled source, object and interface hashes identify the completed Lean compilation. Differences between distributed and compiled Lean sources are confined to comments, with equality of every noncomment byte segment checked. Objects and compiled documentation correspond to their compiled source identities. The package checker verifies the distributed files, not the recorded compiler execution or comment reconciliation. External mathematical assumptions are not proved by these checks.
manuscript_identity_scope: manuscript_sha256 identifies the distributed manuscript. build_context_manuscript_sha256 identifies the manuscript accompanying the frozen build inputs. Lean does not compile the manuscript. These two hashes do not assert that the manuscripts are identical or certify correspondence between manuscript statements and Lean declarations.
